premises.name: AddSubgroup.normalizer
premises.type: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] (S : Set G) : AddSubgroup G
premises.doc:
The `normalizer` of `S` is the subgroup of `G` whose elements satisfy `g + S - g = S`.
When `S` is a subgroup, this is the largest subgroup of `G` inside which `S` is normal.

premises.name: AddSubgroup
premises.type: (G : Type u_3) [AddGroup G] : Type u_3
premises.doc:
An additive subgroup of an additive group `G` is a subset containing 0, closed
under addition and additive inverse. 

[Wikidata Q466109](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q466109)

premises.name: Subgroup
premises.type: (G : Type u_3) [Group G] : Type u_3
premises.doc:
A subgroup of a group `G` is a subset containing 1, closed under multiplication
and closed under multiplicative inverse. 

[Wikidata Q466109](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q466109)

premises.name: AddSubgroup.Normal
premises.type: {A : Type u_2} [AddGroup A] (H : AddSubgroup A) : Prop
premises.doc:
An AddSubgroup `H` is normal if whenever `n ∈ H`, then `g + n - g ∈ H` for every `g : A` 

[Wikidata Q743179](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q743179)
